digest.component_or_area: process audit disposition and decision recovery
propositions: Six process-improvement recommendations from the frozen bleakish-stational-cob audit must be evaluated against prior decisions, janitor outcomes, and implementation tickets to determine reaffirm, refine, reconsider, or defer dispositions.

The escaped-defect metadata recommendation should refine the existing fail-open detected_by capture at creation boundaries rather than mandate a schema field, targeting near-100% coverage for automated filers without global prompting or backfill.

Deterministic plan preflight should extend the current P1-P11 floor only for mechanically decidable, recurrent failure classes with offline replay validation and explicit false-positive ceilings, preserving semantic LLM review for architecture and tradeoffs.

Completion-failure classification must derive reason codes from historical first-non-PASS sidecars offline with inter-rater agreement validation before adding schema, avoiding invalid conflation of implementation defects with unmet ACs or environment failures.

Risk-tiered review should pilot risk reporting without merge enforcement, measuring defects and precision by tier before thresholds, and abandon the human-review framing because this project already implements autonomous Gerrit governance.

Proactive debt management should not include the soft 720-LOC warning (already shipped) and should prioritize remediation only where module size intersects complexity, churn, or architectural centrality, avoiding arbitrary quota targets.
